app.clock_label: Time left in the golden hour
palm.caption: My money is gone
palm.sub: Tell us in under a minute. No typing, no forms, no English needed.
palm.action_hint: Your case opens the moment you tap
palm.promise_otp: We never ask for an OTP or a PIN
palm.promise_typing: Nothing to type, nothing to upload yet
safetyTriage.question: Are they still on the phone with you?
safetyTriage.support: Your case is already open. This question comes first because it changes what you should do right now.
safetyTriage.why: Nothing you do from here can delete your case.
safetyTriage.step_hangup: End the call. Do not explain, do not say goodbye.
safetyTriage.step_silence: Do not tell them you are reporting this.
safetyTriage.step_nothing: Send no more money, no OTP, no documents.
safetyTriage.why_hangup: Real police and real banks never keep you on a call, and never ask you to stay silent.
safetyTriage.share_text: I may have been a victim of financial fraud. Please call me back on a number you know. Do not share any OTP or bank details with anyone.
safetyTriage.share_fallback: We copied a message you can paste to someone you trust.
messageWall.title: Which one is the wrong one?
messageWall.support: Tap the payment you did not make. You do not need to read the whole message — look at the amount.
messageWall.no_time_detail: This message gave a date but no time, so we have not filled in a time. We will not state one we cannot see.
messageWall.upload_note: Upload a screenshot of your bank message and we will read it here on your phone. The image never leaves your device.
messageWall.ocr_reading_detail: This takes a few seconds and happens on your device.
messageWall.ocr_unrecognized: We could not find a payment in that image. Try a clearer screenshot, or pick a message above.
messageWall.something_wrong: Something looks wrong? Fix it here
messageWall.correct_note: We only send what you confirm. A wrong number here could freeze the wrong account.
scope.question: Only this one, or were there more?
scope.why: Each payment may have gone to a different account. Every one needs its own hold.
reachedVia.question: How did they reach you?
reachedVia.support: Tap the one that fits. You never have to choose a legal category — we do that part.
reachedVia.why: This is the only thing the complaint form needs in order to file your case under the right heading.
readBack.sentence_contact: They reached you through {channel}, and you did not agree to this payment.
readBack.sentence_filing: We will report this as a financial fraud, right now.
readBack.fallback_one: You are reporting a financial fraud.
readBack.fallback_three: We will report this as a financial fraud.
readBack.channel_unknown: a way you could not identify
readBack.why: We write the complaint for you. You only have to say whether it is true.
readBack.narrative_meta: {count} characters, plain English, ready for the portal.
caseComplete.heading: Your case is open
caseComplete.spoken: Your case is open. Your reference is {reference}.
caseComplete.your_money_detail: Call 1930 now and read the lines above. The sooner they have your reference number, the sooner the receiving account can be put on hold.
caseComplete.your_job_detail: Do not delete any message from your bank. Do not answer the number that called you. Do not send anything more.
caseComplete.by_tomorrow_detail: Take this case, a photo ID and your bank messages to your nearest cyber crime cell. You can add your ID here whenever you are ready.
caseComplete.not_submitted_title: This has not been filed with cybercrime.gov.in
caseComplete.not_submitted_detail: The portal has no public way for an app to file on your behalf. Rok has prepared your complete complaint — call 1930 or take the downloaded file to the portal to submit it.
calmMode.heading: When you are ready
calmMode.support: None of this is urgent, and none of it was needed to open your case. Take your time, or come back tomorrow.
calmMode.id_prompt: A photo of any ID card
calmMode.id_note: Voter ID, driving licence, passport, PAN or Aadhaar. Any one is enough.
calmMode.privacy: Your ID photo stays on this device for this session only. It is never uploaded, and never saved to storage.
guardianHandoff.title: Let someone help
guardianHandoff.support: A son, a neighbour, a bank clerk. They can continue this case while it stays yours.
guardianHandoff.instruction: Open Rok again on this same device and enter this code to continue the case.
guardianHandoff.not_found: No case found for that code on this device. Check the code and try again.
guardianHandoff.scope_note: In this demo the code works on this device and browser only. Handing a case to a different phone would need a server, which this build deliberately does not have.
raceView.title: NCRP today vs Rok
raceView.subtitle: The same complaint, structured for the investigator who reads it later — or for the money that is moving now.
raceView.table_caption: Every mandatory NCRP field, and how each system obtains it
raceView.source_note: Field list from cybercrime.gov.in's own pre-login instructions and FAQ. Step count from citizen procedure manuals published by Bank of India and L&T Finance.
neverAsk.otp_banner: Rok will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password. Anyone who does is a fraud.
footer.not_official: Not an official Government of India platform — hackathon proof of concept.
